description: Rent a real Chrome browser for up to 60 minutes: opens a live session (optionally at a URL) and returns a session id, a screenshot, the page text and the clickable controls. Drive it step by step with /v1/browser/act (click, type, press, scroll, select, go back). The session stays open 2 minutes after each action. Costs $0.03 USDC per call (x402).
